description: Replace the full set of available tags on a forum channel with the provided list. This overwrites existing tags, so include every tag you want to keep. Requires the Manage Channels permission. Returns a confirmation.

forum_channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the forum channel to set tags on.

tags.description: Complete list of tags to set (replaces all existing tags).

emoji_name.description: Optional unicode emoji shown on the tag.

moderated.description: If true, only members with Manage Threads can apply this tag. Default false.

name: discord_set_forum_tags
